rationale: This is a mechanical MIN-stacking of two already-tested conditioners (the gen-5 labor/plant conjunction and the gen-6 inventory-utilization weight) onto the identical accrual core, and taking the minimum of three ranks compresses the weight toward zero for nearly all firms so the likely outcome is a diluted, narrower version of results already in the archive rather than new economics.

A defensible recombination — the broad non-physical asset numerator re-deflated by assets (not the tail-prone capx+dp) and conditioned on the one real-input channel that shares no accounting variable with it — though it is still the archive's dominant MUL(accrual, IND_RANK(weight)) template and the incremental information over AccrualBloatWithoutLaborExpansion may be small since working capital dominates the broader numerator.

This is the same accrual-bloat × intangible-intensity pairing already tested in gen 2 (AccrualBloatWhereAssetsAreUnverifiable) with only the combiner changed from MIN to MUL, i.e. a cosmetic construction variant of an archived signal rather than a substantively different mechanism.

The supplier-as-informed-monitor mechanism is genuinely distinct from the archive's real-input and capacity conditioners and the sign logic is internally consistent, but the product of asset-side inventory build and negative operating-liability growth is close to a multiplicative restatement of the working-capital accrual itself, so the result may not be economically separable from the existing core.

The three-year frequency gate on sub-replacement capex is a legitimate response to the wrong-signed FMB slopes produced by the earlier one-year rank-product versions, since multiplying the *signed* accrual by a non-negative persistence weight preserves direction where the rank-of-rank forms did not; novelty is modest but the diagnosis-driven fix is sound.

The diagnosis is the sharpest of the batch — large alpha with no FMB slope attributed to the tail-heavy capx+dp denominator — and the response combines a defensible deflator change with an economically independent capacity-contraction conditioner; the only caveat is that changing two things at once will make attribution ambiguous if it works.
